messages:
tess: Deploy stuck in promo step 'fetch-blob' for rc9. deploy-bot returned repeated lease evictions from artifact-cache. Change window in 30m.

omar: Seeing 504s back from cache region eu-west-1, job id promote-901.

kai: Logs: 
```
cache_client: fetch blob sha256:4f2a... error=504 attempts=4 lease=evicted
```

deploy-bot: promote-job-901: failed_step=fetch-blob error=cache_fetch_timeout job_state=FAILED

ci-bot: Verified artifact present in origin. When fetched directly (bypassing cache) checksum matches sha256:4f2a... No storage corruption.

tess: Ok so cache infra is flaky. Two options: delay promo and wait for infra fix, or pin prod back to rc8 to keep cut.

release-mgr: If we miss window a LOT is pushed. Recommend pin to rc8, abort the job, open incident, and schedule re-promote after cache validation.

omar: Agree. Minimal blast: pin + abort. No DB migrations in either.

kai: Commands: `deployctl route pin --env=prod --image=sha256:99b1... --reason="cache eviction"` then `deployctl job abort --id promote-901`

tess: Executing pin now. tagging @kai to observe.

kai: watching.

tess: Pin complete: prod -> 2026.03.19-rc8 sha256:99b1... :white_check_mark:

tess: Aborted promote-901 :ok_hand: deploy-bot confirms job stopped.

ci-bot: Smoke checks against rc8: auth ok, openapi OK, p95 latency within SLO.

release-mgr: Release window preserved. Opening INC-2026-089 for artifact-cache lease evictions and follow-up re-promote playbook. Add note in release-notes about pin.

tess: Thanks everyone. We'll retest rc9 once cache team confirms region stability and then schedule controlled re-promote outside primary window.
